Reuses the existing official_jaecoo_th source: Omoda and Jaecoo share the omodajaecoo.co.th domain (confirmed distinct from chery-thailand.com). IMPORTANT fetch caveat: this URL returned HTTP 403 when fetched through our research tool's default fetch path, but loads fine (200) with a standard browser User-Agent and contains an embedded JSON blob with 'sub_model_name":"OMODA C5 EV MAX+","price":"709000"' -- confirmed independently. The same JSON blob also carries several Jaecoo models' prices, so extraction must pick out the right vehicle by name, same caveat as jaecoo_th_home_price_cards. If the pipeline's own fetcher (User-Agent 'tdr-automotive/price-intelligence-1.0', see price_fetch.py) also gets a 403 here, that is a fetch-layer/WAF issue to solve separately, not a dead source. Only 'OMODA C5 EV' was found on this domain; no separate non-EV Omoda C5 page exists.
